title: Create frozen parameter ID taxonomy in ParameterIDs header with schema version
description:
Create Source/Parameters/ParameterIDs.h defining the frozen, permanent parameter ID taxonomy for ShredBoost (schema version 1). Declare a compile-time schema version constant (e.g. constexpr int kParameterSchemaVersion = 1) and stable string ID constants for every automatable parameter exactly as named: input_trim, tight_cut, mid_freq, mid_amount, drive, tone, level, pick_attack, voicing_mode, oversampling, auto_gain. Use a dedicated namespace (e.g. ShredBoost::ParamID). Document per-parameter range/default in comments: input_trim (-18..+18 dB, default 0), tight_cut (80..400 Hz, default 180), mid_freq (500..1200 Hz, default 720), mid_amount (0..+9 dB, default +4), drive (0..+36 dB, default +12), tone (1..16 kHz, default 6.5), level (-24..+12 dB, default 0), pick_attack (0..+9 dB, default +2), voicing_mode (0..3 choice, default Yng-Grey), oversampling (0..2 choice, default 2x), auto_gain (bool, default Off). This is a header-only, include-guarded (#pragma once) file with no APVTS logic. Do NOT expose any internal DSP states (crossfade, mute-fade, RMS tracker) as parameter IDs.

Before editing, inspect:
- CMakeLists.txt (to confirm Source/ layout and product identity)
- The plan DSP chain and parameter list above for exact IDs, ranges, and defaults.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Source/Parameters/ParameterIDs.h exists and is #pragma once guarded
ParameterIDs.h declares a schema version constant equal to 1
ParameterIDs.h declares stable string ID constants for exactly these 11 parameters: input_trim, tight_cut, mid_freq, mid_amount, drive, tone, level, pick_attack, voicing_mode, oversampling, auto_gain
No internal DSP state (crossfade, mute-fade, RMS tracker) is exposed as a parameter ID
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: expose internal DSP states (crossfade, mute-fade, RMS tracker) as APVTS parameter IDs
add or change parameter IDs beyond the 11 specified parameters
